thread:
tia: quick heads-up — we need to land the release bump and push an annotated tag for the 1.8.0-pre candidate today. checklist: annotated tag, signed artifacts uploaded to the GH draft, SBOM + checksums, CI green. can owners confirm?

alex: i'm taking tag + gpg signing. will wait for artifacts in the draft.

ben: e2e had one flaky test, fixing now. should be green in ~30m.

maria: uploading build artifacts to the GH draft as they finish. will attach a draft release body with the changelog snippet. ping me when tag exists so i can attach signed files.

release-bot: CI status for main: all checks passing (lint ✅, unit ✅, integration ✅), latest pipeline id: 48231.

sam: quick Q — who is the canonical owner of the release GPG key? need to know for key escrow notes. @alex?

alex: yep, i have the key. i'll use the USB HSM on my laptop. signing command i'm going to run: `gpg --batch --yes --detach-sign -a dist/redwood-inference-1.8.0-pre.tar.gz`

tia: perfect. please also generate a SHA256 checksum file named `checksums-1.8.0-pre.sha256` (one-line format). we need SBOM (SPDX) attached too — `sbom/spdx.json`.

maria: understood — adding `checksums-1.8.0-pre.sha256` and `sbom-spdx.json` to the draft now.

ben: pushed a small fix, CI retriggered. ETA for full green: ~20m. will post status here.

alex: once i sign artifacts i'll upload `.asc` files to the draft and then tia can push the annotated tag. what tag message do we want? short changelog + authors?

tia: keep tag annotation lightweight: one-line summary + link to GH draft. e.g. `v1.8.0-pre — release candidate: fixes e2e flakiness and batching regression. see draft: <link>`

sam: add to the release notes that this includes theOptimize caching tweak — people might want to pin configs.

release-bot: reminder: publishing window closes at 16:30 PT for this cycle.

maria: artifacts uploaded and checksums present. uploaded `dist/*.tar.gz`, `dist/*.tar.gz.asc`, `checksums-1.8.0-pre.sha256`, `sbom-spdx.json`. draft url: https://github.com/redwood-inference/releases/draft/518

ben: CI is green now. all tests passing.

alex: artifacts signed and `.asc` files attached. i'm ready — tia you can create the annotated tag when ready.

tia: tagging now: `git tag -a v1.8.0-pre -m "v1.8.0-pre — RC: fix e2e + batching"` then `git push origin v1.8.0-pre`. pushing... :rocket:

maria: saw the tag — linking draft to tag and publishing draft as release candidate.

ben: updated changelog snippet in the release body: `- Fix e2e flakiness (regression in http client)
- Improve batching heuristics for short sequences`

tia: published the draft as a pre-release. timeline met — tag at 15:48 PT, publish 15:53 PT. if anyone notices checksum/signature mismatches or missing SBOM, call it out here and i'll roll back the draft.

sam: looks good from my side. thanks all. :tada:
